item.title: Household energy bills set to fall by £117 from April
item.description: Ofgem’s April price cap is forecast to fall 7% to £1,641, cutting typical household energy bills by £117 after government policy changes. Read more: Household energy bills set to fall by £117 from April

item.title: The Digital Balancing Act: How Growing Businesses Can Move Faster Without Sacrificing Security
item.description: In today’s market, every single company is a technology company. It does not matter if you sell clothing, offer financial advice, or run a local delivery service. Your customers find you online, they buy from you through digital platforms, and they expect your services to be available 24 hours a day. Read more: The Digital Balancing Act: How Growing Businesses Can Move Faster Without Sacrificing Security

item.title: UK Online Casinos Face Further Increased Costs
item.description: Recently published figures for Q3 of the 2025-26 financial year revealed gross gambling yield (GGY) for UK online casinos of £1.5 billion. Will they be able to continue posting such results amid rising costs in the coming months? Read more: UK Online Casinos Face Further Increased Costs

item.title: Understanding the Role of an Ovulation Tracker in Modern Fertility Care
item.description: Advances in digital health have transformed fertility awareness from traditional methods into precise, personalized monitoring. Read more: Understanding the Role of an Ovulation Tracker in Modern Fertility Care

item.title: UK firms back home market for growth as Barclays unveils £22bn lending fund
item.description: Barclays’ Business Prosperity Index shows 58% of UK firms see Britain as the best place to grow, as the bank launches a £22bn Business Prosperity Fund. Read more: UK firms back home market for growth as Barclays unveils £22bn lending fund

item.title: Virgin Media O2 owners strike £2bn deal for Netomnia in fibre consolidation push
item.description: Liberty Global and Telefónica have agreed a £2bn deal to acquire Netomnia, expanding Virgin Media O2’s fibre reach to 20m UK premises and intensifying competition with Openreach. Read more: Virgin Media O2 owners strike £2bn deal for Netomnia in fibre consolidation push

item.title: Small businesses warn of April ‘perfect storm’ as costs surge
item.description: The Federation of Small Businesses warns 35% of small firms may close or cut output as higher wages, energy bills and tax changes hit in April. Read more: Small businesses warn of April ‘perfect storm’ as costs surge

item.title: Nine in 10 high-risk pension funds fail to beat FTSE 100 over five years
item.description: Analysis shows 89% of medium-high and high-risk pension funds underperformed the FTSE 100 over five years, with some losing more than 90% of investor capital. Read more: Nine in 10 high-risk pension funds fail to beat FTSE 100 over five years

item.title: Youth unemployment hits 11-year high as rate cut expectations build
item.description: Youth unemployment has risen to 16.1%, its highest level in over a decade, adding pressure on the Bank of England to cut interest rates next month. Read more: Youth unemployment hits 11-year high as rate cut expectations build
